title: A Change to the Departure Platform
instructions: Listen carefully. Choose the option that best matches what is said or implied.

audio.description: A station announcement about a platform change.

transcript.text: The 10:18 service will leave from platform six instead of platform four. Please use the footbridge because the lifts are temporarily out of order. The train still leaves at 10:18, so check the display before boarding and allow time to reach the other platform. Staff are available nearby if you need help.

questions.prompt: What has changed about the service?
questions.explanation: The announcement says it will leave from platform six instead of platform four; it explicitly says the time remains 10:18.

questions.prompt: Why should passengers use the footbridge?
options: The lifts are not working at the moment.
The train is too long for the usual platform.
questions.explanation: The speaker explains, “the lifts are temporarily out of order,” so the footbridge is the available route.

questions.prompt: What does the final instruction suggest?
options: Passengers should wait outside the station.
The information may need checking again.
The train will probably be cancelled.
questions.explanation: Passengers are asked to check the display before boarding, implying they should confirm the information there.
